name: BHB Brauholding Bayern-Mitte AG
summary: BHB Brauholding Bayern-Mitte AG engages in the brewery business in Germany. It offers wheat beer, bottom-fermented beerspecialties, and beer mixed drinks, as well as mineral water and non-alcoholic soft drinks, and thirst quenchers. The company was founded in 1882 and is based in Ingolstadt, Germany.
